# Les Roches Retreat

> Six private villas with infinity pools above Santa Teresa, on the Pacific
> coast of Costa Rica. Each villa has two bedrooms, two bathrooms, its own
> pool, and sleeps four. Booked and paid for directly on this site.

## Facts

- Location: Santa Teresa, Nicoya peninsula, Puntarenas province, Costa Rica.
- Six villas: Casa Opale, Casa Onyx, Casa Jade, Casa Topaze, Casa Agate, Casa Ambre.
- Each: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, private infinity pool, air conditioning,
  fully equipped kitchen, high-speed WiFi, private parking. Sleeps 4.
- All six together: 24 guests, 12 bedrooms, 12 bathrooms.
- Nearest beach: 6 to 7 minutes. Nearest airport: Tambor (TMU), a 30-minute
  flight from San Jose (SJO).
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00. Daily housekeeping except Sunday.
- Pets: one dog per villa, on request.
- Payment: the full stay is charged to the card at booking, taxes included.
  No deposit, nothing to settle on arrival.
- Cancellation: up to 60 days before arrival, 96% is refunded to the card;
  the 4% bank fee is not returned. Within 60 days, half is refunded.
- Minimum stay: it depends on the date. Most often 2 nights, sometimes 3.
  The calendar on each villa page applies the exact minimum for the dates
  chosen and says what it is.
- Prices change by season and length of stay. The price shown for a set of
  dates is the price paid: no cleaning fee, no service charge.

## Pages

- [Villas](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villas.html): the six villas, with
  live availability and prices for any dates.
- [Casa Opale](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-opale.html): ocean front.
- [Casa Onyx](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-onyx.html): the most
  panoramic ocean view.
- [Casa Jade](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-jade.html): ocean view.
- [Casa Topaze](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-topaze.html): jungle garden.
- [Casa Agate](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-agate.html): garden and pool.
- [Casa Ambre](https://lesrochesretreat.com/villa-ambre.html): sunset garden.
- [FAQ](https://lesrochesretreat.com/faq.html): booking, arrival, villas, the area.
- [Booking conditions](https://lesrochesretreat.com/booking-conditions.html).
- [Santa Teresa](https://lesrochesretreat.com/santa-teresa.html): the area.
- [Journal](https://lesrochesretreat.com/journal.html): 14 guides to Santa
  Teresa, each in English, French and Spanish.

## Languages

English at the root, French under /fr/, Spanish under /es/. Every page exists
in the three languages and they are linked to each other.

## Please note

Prices and availability come from a live feed and change daily. Do not quote
a nightly price from memory: point to the villa page, where the calendar
gives the real price for the dates asked.
